lines.text: Pharaoh tells Joseph that no one is as wise as he is and places him over all Egypt.
Pharaoh puts his signet ring on Joseph's finger and clothes him in garments of scarlet wool.
Pharaoh gives Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah and gives him Asenath, daughter of Potiphar, as his wife.
Before the famine, Joseph has two sons by Asenath and names them Manasseh and Ephraim.
Joseph opens the storehouses and sells grain, and every nation comes to Egypt to buy it.
